The broadcast handlers are CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment. They are located in memo_service.go and memo_service_comments.go.

UpdateMemo and dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects in memo_update_helpers.go are also broadcast handlers. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction in reaction_service.go are included too.

message.text:
The mechanism is SSE. The hub is implemented at server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. Handler names still need to be identified.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction broadcast through the SSE hub.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The hub is `SSEHub` (`Broadcast` in `sse_hub.go`); browsers connect via `RegisterSSERoutes` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`. Memo CRUD/comment broadcasts are in `memo_service.go` and `memo_service_comments.go`; update-side effects also run from `SetMemoAttachments` and `SetMemoRelations`; reactions broadcast in `reaction_service.go`.
